resources.string: Send music, books and pictures, browse the card and update ByOS
For a player that already runs ByOS, over Wi-Fi. The steps above are only for the first install.
Not in this version of the app
This build of ByOS Install cannot talk to ByOS Sync yet. Look for a newer version of the app.
Join the same Wi-Fi network as this phone.
Open **Settings › ByOS Sync** and turn on **Wi-Fi sync**.
The first time only: open **Pair new device** and leave that screen open.
The app looks for players on this Wi-Fi network. Nothing leaves your network.
Open Pair new device on the player
The address is on the player, in **Settings › ByOS Sync**.
Forget a player to pair with it again.
Type the 6-digit code shown on the player.
That code did not match. The player now shows a new code: type that one.
The player asks whether this phone may connect.
The code proves that the phone talks to your player and not to another device. After pairing, everything sent over Wi-Fi is encrypted.
Connect to the player again to go on. What you chose is kept.
Any file or folder from this phone
The folder is made on the card if it is not there. To choose another folder, open it in Files and tap Send files here.
Top of the card, where the player looks for r3ii_2025.upt
A folder is sent with everything in it. Hidden files are left out. Names the card does not accept are changed (for example ? becomes _).
Off: a different file with the same name is kept and reported
Keep the app open and the player on. If the connection breaks, connect again: the transfer goes on where it stopped.
%1$d sent, %2$d already there, %3$d with a problem.
A different file has this name
Too big for the card (4 GB limit)
Browse, rename, move and delete on the card
Open the folder where it goes, then tap Move here.
The file is deleted from the card. This cannot be undone.
The folder and everything in it are deleted from the card. This cannot be undone.
Artists, albums and songs on the player
The app reads a copy of the player\'s music library. Nothing is changed on the player.
The library shows what the player has found on the card. New files appear after the player scans them.
Full reflash with a ByOS built on this phone

Builds ByOS %1$s on this phone from the official firmware, exactly as for the first install, and sends it to the player over this connection. Then you start the install from the player\'s menu. This is the full reflash path, not a signed over-the-air update.
Files already on the card with the same content are not sent again.
%1$d files on the card (%2$d were already there), with **%3$s** at the top. Now start the update on the player.
Check that the player is on, on the same Wi-Fi, and that Wi-Fi sync is turned on in Settings › ByOS Sync.
Connect again. A transfer goes on where it stopped.
The player is not the one paired with this phone
If the player was reset, forget it here and pair again. Otherwise another device may be answering in its place.
Open Settings › ByOS Sync › Pair new device on the player, then connect again to pair. Your old pairing is kept until the new one succeeds.
The player does not know this phone any more
Look for a newer version of the app.
Pairing is not open on the player
On the player, open Settings › ByOS Sync › Pair new device and try again.
The player did not allow this phone
Try again and tap Allow on the player within two minutes.
Another device is connected, or an update is being installed. Try again in a moment.
Wait a minute before trying again.
Delete something in Files, or send fewer files.
The SD card is not available
Check that the card is in the player and that the player is not connected to a computer as a USB drive.
Something with this name is already there
This name is not allowed on the card
The file is too big for the card
The card changed. Go back and open the folder again.
A folder cannot be moved into itself
The player\'s ByOS cannot do this
Update ByOS on the player first.
The card could not be read or written
Try again. If it happens again, check the card in a computer.
A file on this phone could not be read
It may have been moved or deleted. Choose it again.
Check that Wi-Fi sync is on in Settings › ByOS Sync, or type the address shown there.
A signed update downloaded on this phone
Download **hibyos-update.json** and **hibyos-payload-<version>.tar** from the ByOS releases, then choose both (or one, then the other). The signature is checked on this phone and again on the player.
Not the payload of this version
Reinstall ByOS from this app first if the player refuses it.
The player asks you to confirm before it installs anything. Keep it charged (30 % or more, or on the charger).
This player\'s ByOS cannot install updates over ByOS Sync
Copy the two files to the ByOS/ota folder of the card, or update ByOS from the player\'s Software Update page.
Keep the app open and the player on. If the connection breaks, try again: what is on the player already is not sent twice.
The player checks the signature and the payload. This takes a few seconds.
The player asks whether to install ByOS %1$s. Tap **Install** on the player.
Do not turn the player off. If something fails, the player puts the previous ByOS back by itself.
Everything is ready on the player.
The ByOS screen restarts on the player. To connect again, open **Settings › ByOS Sync** on the player.
Tap **Restart Now** on the player to finish. Then open ByOS Sync on the player to connect again.
The update was cancelled on the player. ByOS %1$s stays ready on the card: install it whenever you want.
ByOS %1$s is checked and waiting on the card. To install it, open **Settings › Software Update** on the player.
This update is not signed by ByOS
Download hibyos-update.json again from the official ByOS releases. A changed or unofficial file is never installed.
The update files do not match
Download both files of the same version again and choose them.
The payload is not the one this update names
Choose the hibyos-payload tar of the same version as hibyos-update.json. If it is, download it again: it may be damaged.
Choose hibyos-update.json and hibyos-payload-<version>.tar. To send other files, use Send Files.
The player already has this version or a newer one
Nothing to do. To go back to an older ByOS on purpose, install it anyway.
The player\'s battery is too low
Charge it to 30 % or more, or plug it in, then try again.
This update needs a newer ByOS firmware
Reinstall ByOS with this app (Reinstall ByOS), then install this update.
The update is not on the player
Send it again: the files may have been removed from the card.
The install is taking too long
Look at the player\'s screen. Then connect again: Settings › About on the player shows the ByOS version.
The player looks for new, changed and deleted songs on the card, then the library is read again. With a large library this takes a minute.
%1$s added to the card. They appear in Artists, Albums and Songs after a library update.
Keep the player on. The library is shown again when the player has finished.
This player cannot update its library on request
Start a library update from the player\'s own music settings, then read the library again here. Songs that were only replaced are already up to date.
%1$s are deleted from the card, with the album folder when it holds nothing else (cover, lyrics). This cannot be undone.
All the songs of this artist (%1$s) are deleted from the card, with the album folders that hold nothing else. This cannot be undone.
Files were moved, renamed or deleted on the card. Update the library so that the player shows the change.
Send music with Send Files, then update the library. Songs already on the card appear once the player has scanned them.
Songs to Music, pictures to Pictures, books to Books, the firmware to the top of the card
These are the files of a signed ByOS update. They are not copied to the card: Install Update checks them and installs them.
Not enough space on the card
%1$s to send, %2$s free. Delete something in Files or choose fewer files.
Nothing to send: only files can be shared to the player.
Progress of files and ByOS updates sent to the player
You can leave the app: the transfer goes on and its progress is in the notifications. If the connection drops, it connects again by itself and goes on where it stopped.
Check the spelling, or search for fewer words.
Code shown on the player, %1$d of 6 digits typed
In use by a computer over USB: eject it there first
The player does not say why
The card is formatted FAT32, which keeps files under 4 GB. Split the file, or format the card as exFAT on a computer.
A file and a folder were mixed up
Send music, books or pictures from this phone with Send Files.
It is saved as a .m3u8 file in the Playlists folder of the card.
Use ••• › Add to a playlist on a song or an album, or make a new one below.
Use ••• › Add to a playlist on songs and albums.
Playlists are .m3u8 files in the Playlists folder of the card: the player and computers can open them.
